# Melissa Heathers

> Melissa Heathers is an author, speaker and creative visionary based in Kitchener, Ontario, Canada. She wrote the poetry collection "dear Ego, dear Heart", created the children's series "The Goddess Gems: A Mystical Adventure", and is founder, executive producer and host of "The Book Crawl", which streams on EzWay TV under The Women's Channel. Her philosophy: every story is worth savouring.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.soulsecrets.ca/): overview and where to begin
- [dear Ego, dear Heart](https://www.soulsecrets.ca/dear-ego-dear-heart/): a poetic tale of the war within, written as letters between the ego and the heart
- [The Book Crawl](https://www.soulsecrets.ca/the-book-crawl/): a televised literary experience for authors
- [The Goddess Gems](https://www.soulsecrets.ca/goddess-gems/): a children's story world; Book 1 is Rose Court, the Goddess Gem of Love
- [About Melissa Heathers](https://www.soulsecrets.ca/melissa-heathers/): biography and milestones
- [Press & media kit](https://www.soulsecrets.ca/press/): approved bios, headshot, quick facts, interviews
- [Mel's Meditations](https://www.soulsecrets.ca/meditations/): three complimentary meditations
- [Contact](https://www.soulsecrets.ca/contact/): speaking, Book Crawl guest applications, press
